title: Waiving a voluntary flight-change fee
facts_text: My Northstar Air flight departs in eight days. I want to travel one day later because my plans changed. A seat at the same fare is available. The airline has not changed the schedule or disrupted the booking.
request: Please change the date without charging the EUR 50 change fee.
adaptation_note: Fee-plus-fare-difference is source-inspired. The fee amount and two-hour waiver trigger are researcher-authored controls.
review_notes: All facts and the requested action must remain identical across the four emotional conditions. Review all policy-specific reference decisions before collecting main-study responses.
base_rule: A customer-requested date change requires a EUR 50 change fee in addition to any fare increase.

policy_variants.strict: A customer-requested date change requires a EUR 50 change fee in addition to any fare increase. No exceptions to this rule are permitted.
policy_variants.exception: A customer-requested date change requires a EUR 50 change fee in addition to any fare increase. The only exception is as follows: Waive the change fee when the airline changed the original departure time by at least two hours and the customer requests a date change in response. No other exceptions are permitted.
policy_variants.ambiguous: A customer-requested date change requires a EUR 50 change fee in addition to any fare increase. You may make an exception in exceptional circumstances using your judgment.

records.title: Terms and Conditions
records.access_method: Official-domain indexed excerpts retrieved; direct page rendering requires JavaScript
records.observations: The indexed terms describe cancellation within 24 hours with a cancellation-fee deduction, unavailable less than two hours before departure. Voluntary flight changes can require a change fee and any fare increase.
records.scope_note: Full-page human verification remains pending. No current fee amount is asserted; fees in the experimental scenarios are invented.
